title: Mastering Your Inner Identity
voiceover_full: Stop trying to change your habits until you change who you believe you are. Action follows identity. When you shift your self-concept from a seeker to a master, execution becomes automatic. Master your mind, rewrite your story, and the world will mirror your inner strength.
